visual.general_description: Blue-tinted frontal abdominal and pelvic radiograph with a very large gas-filled rounded viscus occupying most of the upper and mid abdomen.
visual.detailed_description: Grayscale-blue radiograph showing the lumbar spine in the midline, the bony pelvis, both hip joints and proximal femora, and lower rib margins at the top corners. A very large rounded lucent structure with a thin curved wall spans much of the upper and mid abdomen on both sides of the spine and extends down toward the pelvic brim. Smaller gas lucencies lie lateral to it on the left side of the image. A small round bright opacity lies near the midline of the pelvis. The edges look like a film or screen photographed with a dark border at the top and right. No letters, side markers, patient text, arrows or measurements are visible.

visual.general_description: Color intraoperative photograph of an open abdomen with gloved hands, metal retractors and pink-red hollow viscera in the wound.
visual.detailed_description: Portrait photograph taken from above an opened abdominal wall. Several gloved hands (white, tan and gray gloves) and two metal retractors hold the wound open. Within the wound are pink to red smooth-walled organ loops, with pale yellowish tissue on the left and a darker reddish-brown irregular area at the lower centre of the wound. Skin of the abdominal wall with blood smears surrounds the wound, with blue and green drapes at the right and lower edges. A pink tube with a blue stripe runs vertically at the lower left. No letters, labels, arrows, scale or text are visible.

visual.general_description: Two side-by-side unlabelled operative photographs, each showing gloved hands and metal retractors at a deep wound; the left shows a small reddish rounded structure and the right shows a long thin instrument held at the wound.
visual.detailed_description: The image is made of two adjacent frames of lower, video-like resolution, with no printed labels. The left frame shows two gloved hands and a spoon-shaped retractor at the lower left around a narrow deep wound with pink tissue; a small reddish rounded structure lies in the wound at about mid-height. The right frame shows a gloved hand pinching a long thin metal instrument that points down into a deep wound, with a wide metal retractor blade at the lower centre and pink to red tissue at the left of the wound. A defect or hole in the stomach wall cannot be identified in either frame. No letters, arrows or text are visible.

visual.general_description: Close-up color intraoperative photograph of gloved hands pinching a pink bowel segment, with further pink bowel loops and a retractor below.
visual.detailed_description: Low-resolution close-up. At the upper left, gloved fingers of two hands pinch and hold a pale pink tubular bowel segment, with a small dark spot near its edge. Beneath it lie smooth glistening pink bowel loops with a tiny red dot on one loop, and a metal retractor at the lower right edge; tan skin is at the right edge. Darker red tissue is at the upper right. A saccular outpouching is not clearly separable from the pinched bowel wall. No letters, arrows or text are visible.
